hypothesis: Distinguish a failed breakout below entry price from a slow but intact launch: only exit no-demand trades whose second-session close is below entry price.
source: AI hypothesis recorded in goal.md after full-candidate no-demand-v1 rejection; training outcomes already exposed
only_change: On the 474 original independent fills, if entry-session and next-market-session highs both remain below entry_price*1.03 AND second-session close < entry_price, sell at third-session open strictly before original exit. Equal close keeps original exit. Missing close keeps original exit. Existing blocked-fill handling is unchanged.
training: Entry 2016-2022 and original exit <= 2022-12-31; no testing-period bars
cost: T+1; commission 0.0003; slippage 10bps; historical stamp tax; unchanged net_round_trip
gate: Keep provisionally only if mean net return >= original baseline and positive. Report win rate, payoff, changed winners and losers, yearly deltas. No threshold or day-count search.
failure_action: Reject this sell; do not tune the cost boundary or demand threshold. Keep full original baseline and use loss-path evidence to identify a different mechanism.
scope: All completed independent training fills, not all raw signals. Training censored and unfilled candidates are not newly replayed here.
